name: hub-look
description: The weapon viewer and details tabs look right in the shared KydlCore theme, the 3D weapon turns and zooms, and F6 / Esc open and close the hub with real keys

steps.message: Press F6, pick WhipItUp. Do the Viewer, Details and Settings tabs use the shared look (dark panel, gold accents, readable text, nothing cut off)?
On the Viewer tab pick a weapon and rank: does the 3D weapon show, turn when you drag, zoom with the wheel and reset?
Press Esc. Is the hub closed and can you move / look around again (input released)?
